mentions.name: Topicle
mentions.description: A social media platform based in Australia that aims to solve misinformation, astroturfing and inauthentic posting. It detects and counters bad actors with automated mechanisms improved using AI, while supporting features such as video upload and encoding, image upload, CSAM and NSFW detection, LLM-generated text detection, auto-translation using DeepL, and compliance with age verification laws. Native iOS and Android apps have launched alongside the web platform, with a backend built in Swift Vapor.
mentions.problem: Artificially created comment threads pushing narratives and the ability to buy likes and upvotes to shape opinion go unaddressed on big social media platforms, and there was no non-US-based option for users concerned about identity subpoenas for criticizing the government.

mentions.name: Topicle
mentions.description: A community platform positioned as an alternative to Reddit that aggressively polices bots, spam and astroturfing and has strong guardrails against bad moderation: no private profiles for bots to hide behind, every mod action can be appealed, mod logs are public, and LLM posts are blocked.
mentions.problem: There is a lot of obviously inauthentic activity and questionable moderation on Reddit.

mentions.name: Topicle
mentions.description: Topicle is a Reddit-inspired link sharing, voting and discussion platform that rethinks moderation, anti-abuse and privacy to address major pain points of link-sharing sites. Every moderation action has an admin appeal, bots and astroturfing are aggressively monitored and policed, comment histories are always visible, and write operations are blocked from VPNs and datacenter IPs. All analytics are self-hosted (Umami) with no data leakage to ad networks. Threads are live via websockets with realtime post and comment scores, realtime notifications, and immediate DMs. The backend is built on Swift/Vapor with a React Router 7 SSR frontend, there is an existing PWA, and a native SwiftUI iOS app is currently being built to reach the mobile-majority internet.
mentions.problem: Addresses the biggest pain points of link-sharing and discussion platforms: moderation, anti-abuse (bots and astroturfing), and privacy, with the added challenge of cold-start for a new social platform.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Topicle (https://topicle.com), a Reddit-inspired link sharing, voting and discussion platform that rethinks a bunch of basic aspects like moderation, anti-abuse and privacy to try to address some of the biggest pain points.
